dedupe_keys.name: ground based magnetometer observations at entoto observatory ent ethiopia during the march and april 2025 geomagnetic storms

description: This Zenodo dataset publishes one-second ground magnetometer observations from the Entoto Observatory in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia (9.10° N, 38.80° E), during two geomagnetic storms in 2025. The record read on 2026-09-28 says it covers the storms of 19 to 25 March and 13 to 18 April 2025, with the northward (X), eastward (Y) and vertical (Z) components and total field intensity (F) in nanoteslas, in separate CSV files for each storm and for quiet reference days, with a README; it notes that Entoto is not part of the INTERMAGNET network. It was published on 16 June 2026 under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Coverage is one low-latitude station in East Africa. Access is free download. Caveats: data quality control is described only in the README, and one station cannot give the spatial field needed for geoelectric modelling on its own. It supports studies of geomagnetically induced currents in low-latitude power grids and pipelines, where storm effects are less studied. Related records: data-may-2024-storm-gic-observations and data-nsmc-china-national-space-weather-monitoring-warning-centre complement it.
